title: MONSTER V5 Step 2 — Main Proof Concurrency Repair
root_cause: DevSystem targeted CI grouped every refs/heads/main run into one cancel-in-progress concurrency slot, so unrelated later main pushes cancelled valid merged-main certification before required critical lanes could finish.
repair: SHA-isolate concurrency for push events on refs/heads/main while preserving ref-based cancel-in-progress behavior for pull_request, workflow_dispatch, and non-main refs.
proof_policy: Exact clean repair head must pass permanent-contract, DevSystem final gate, terminal receipt, merge, merged-main full certification, then freeze this dedicated repair ledger as MONSTER_V5_STEP2_CI_REPAIR without changing the original MONSTER_V5_STEP2 freeze entry.
